# BAD-073 — A lapsed admin session turns a server action into a dead end

## Brief
When the operator's session has expired, submitting a dashboard form does not send them to sign in — the action POST is rewritten to /login by the proxy, the client gets a redirect where it expected an action response, and the page replaces itself with 'This page couldnt load / Reload to try again, or go back'. Reloading then does go to /login, so the recovery exists but the screen does not name it, and the work in the form is gone. For an internal operator tool the honest behaviour is to land on the sign-in form with the destination preserved, which the proxy already computes.

Evidence: Not diagnosed: why the session lapsed after roughly two minutes rather than at GoTrue's default expiry. That may be local-only and is the part to confirm before treating the timeout itself as a bug — the dead-end rendering is reproducible regardless of why the session ended.
